summary: Short Rankin Street kerb with homes 12 m away on its own side.

drivers.seclusion: Two detached homes 12 m south, a carport 5 m; more homes within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a residential street; room beside the lane looks adequate but section is only 11 m, about one van length.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light traffic expected.
drivers.convention: 2P parking 9am-5pm Mon-Fri signed; cars parked on the north kerb in QLD imagery, no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Dwellings within 12 m on own side
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the south side shades the kerb, mostly from the south and west.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is level enough to stop on

best_section.where: South kerb of Rankin Street, outside the treed, vacant-looking frontage
